name: codable-resume
description: Codable resume in Typst — edit in code, export to PDF

scripts.build:tech-lead: typst compile --root . --input profile=tech-lead templates/modern.typ resume-tech-lead-modern.pdf && typst compile --root . --input profile=tech-lead --input photo=true templates/modern.typ resume-tech-lead-modern-photo.pdf
scripts.build:java: typst compile --root . --input profile=java templates/modern.typ resume-java-modern.pdf && typst compile --root . --input profile=java --input photo=true templates/modern.typ resume-java-modern-photo.pdf
scripts.build:engineering-manager: typst compile --root . --input profile=engineering-manager templates/modern.typ resume-engineering-manager-modern.pdf && typst compile --root . --input profile=engineering-manager --input photo=true templates/modern.typ resume-engineering-manager-modern-photo.pdf
scripts.build:modern: typst compile --root . --input profile=tech-lead templates/modern.typ resume-modern.pdf && typst compile --root . --input profile=tech-lead --input photo=true templates/modern.typ resume-modern-photo.pdf
scripts.build:original: typst compile --root . --input profile=tech-lead templates/original.typ resume-original.pdf && typst compile --root . --input profile=tech-lead --input photo=true templates/original.typ resume-original-photo.pdf
scripts.build:photo: typst compile --root . --input profile=tech-lead --input photo=true resume.typ resume-photo.pdf
scripts.watch:photo: typst watch --root . --input profile=tech-lead --input photo=true resume.typ resume-photo.pdf
